name: Borgmästarbruket - Kyrkoryr
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Borgmästarbruket to Kyrkoryr, mostly gravel road with forest-path sections, passing Torp, Lerbergsnäset, Harska/Södra Harska and Harskabukten; official sources describe this as a new section after a larger northward reroute, and third-party route apps have stale Harska/Kyrkoryr routing risks
